_comment: The Game Master's requests to ADD a sound to an in-game event, written by the wiki (server-merged, per-entry). Key: <event id>/<n>. Value: {event, sound (catalog id or composer/<set>), pitch, volume_db, max_random_pitch_semis, note, requested_at}. The composer (games-audio) agent reads these at run start, wires the sound in its engine, and DELETES the entry it acted on (read-modify-write, like feedback).

player.die/msh0z0uo.note: This is the female die sound effect. Can't assign a separate voice to the male (you need to fix that)
